revision: round 4 rev 4: on each stop the camera keeps gliding (0.5 m sideways in the flight's direction plus a 0.4 m push-in) with a middle key on each hold, instead of almost parking. Stop ranges, holds, nodes and caption anchors unchanged since the round 4 QA fix.
notes: progress = the page scroll of the pinned <scene-3d> section, 0..1 (the same progress the player uses; its keys are placed with the player's smoothstep ease, so these ranges are in page-scroll terms). range = the part of the scroll that belongs to the stop (from the middle of the flight before to the middle of the flight after); hold = the camera slides slowly past the stop and its lamp is lit: show the caption fully there. caption_anchor = [x, y] of the screen, 0..1 from the top left, where the caption box starts (align: left|center). node = the named GLB node of the stop (an empty anchor at the robot's chest); anchor_world = a point over the robot's head in the scene's coordinates (the same Z-up frame as the scroll keys in scene-3d.json), for a site that projects its own anchor.
